trace.scope: Own incoming state forms every operand. Physical QKV GEMM changes width/kernel; restored fused strides do not establish native projection parity. No archived normalized/read/product/bases or full GU/output contraction.

No archived normalized/read/product/bases/targets before seal and observed process exit. All learned work paid.

work.scope: Physical BF16 QKV plus own FP64 GU/output and live attention/moments. Both post-exit diagnostics retained as observations. Original maps, clocks, normalization/RMS/RoPE/SiLU/softmax/scalar/data work remain paid/additional.
